_comment: September 24 verified snapshot references. Live quality claims require a dated provider run.

cases.question: How many sales observations are in the export for 2025?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS sales_observation_count FROM transactions WHERE transaction_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND transaction_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: كم عدد سجلات المبيعات الواردة في البيانات لعام 2025؟
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS sales_observation_count FROM transactions WHERE transaction_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND transaction_date < DATE '2026-01-01'

cases.question: Which five source districts had the highest exported sales value in 2025?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT district, SUM(price_aed) AS sales_value_aed FROM transactions WHERE transaction_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND transaction_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY district ORDER BY sales_value_aed DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: ما المناطق المصدرية الخمس الأعلى من حيث قيمة المبيعات الواردة في بيانات عام 2025؟
cases.reference_sql: SELECT district, SUM(price_aed) AS sales_value_aed FROM transactions WHERE transaction_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND transaction_date < DATE '2026-01-01' GROUP BY district ORDER BY sales_value_aed DESC LIMIT 5

cases.question: What was the sum of source-labelled residential lease value for Q1 and Q2 2026, in AED?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(active_value_aed) AS residential_lease_value_aed FROM rental_observations WHERE source_file = 'Residential Leases/lease_price_by_period.xlsx' AND period_end IN (DATE '2026-03-31', DATE '2026-06-30')

cases.question: ما مجموع قيمة الإيجارات السكنية الواردة في المصدر للربعين الأول والثاني من 2026 بالدرهم؟
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(active_value_aed) AS residential_lease_value_aed FROM rental_observations WHERE source_file = 'Residential Leases/lease_price_by_period.xlsx' AND period_end IN (DATE '2026-03-31', DATE '2026-06-30')

cases.question: How many source-labelled residential leased units were recorded at the end of Q2 2026?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT SUM(source_leased_units) AS leased_units_count FROM rental_observations WHERE source_file = 'Residential Leases/lease_residential.xlsx' AND period_end = DATE '2026-06-30'

cases.question: What was the percentage change from June 2025 to June 2026 in the Abu Dhabi City all-rents index for all residential property types and all zones?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT 100 * (new.index_value - old.index_value) / NULLIF(old.index_value, 0) AS rent_index_change_pct FROM price_indices AS old JOIN price_indices AS new ON old.source_file = new.source_file AND old.municipality = new.municipality AND old.source_area_group = new.source_area_group AND old.property_group = new.property_group AND old.application_type = new.application_type WHERE old.source_file = 'Price Indices/rent_price_index.xlsx' AND old.municipality = 'Abu Dhabi City' AND old.source_area_group = '(all zones)' AND old.property_group = '(all property types)' AND old.application_type = '(all rents)' AND old.period_end = DATE '2025-06-30' AND new.period_end = DATE '2026-06-30'

cases.question: ما نسبة التغير من يونيو 2025 إلى يونيو 2026 في مؤشر جميع الإيجارات لجميع أنواع العقارات السكنية وجميع المناطق في مدينة أبوظبي؟
cases.reference_sql: SELECT 100 * (new.index_value - old.index_value) / NULLIF(old.index_value, 0) AS rent_index_change_pct FROM price_indices AS old JOIN price_indices AS new ON old.source_file = new.source_file AND old.municipality = new.municipality AND old.source_area_group = new.source_area_group AND old.property_group = new.property_group AND old.application_type = new.application_type WHERE old.source_file = 'Price Indices/rent_price_index.xlsx' AND old.municipality = 'Abu Dhabi City' AND old.source_area_group = '(all zones)' AND old.property_group = '(all property types)' AND old.application_type = '(all rents)' AND old.period_end = DATE '2025-06-30' AND new.period_end = DATE '2026-06-30'

cases.question: For Al Reem Island apartments in Q2 2026, what is the leased-unit-weighted annual rent estimate in AED, and how many leased units and layouts matched?
cases.reference_sql: WITH units AS (SELECT period_end, municipality, district, property_type, layout, SUM(source_leased_units) AS unit_count FROM rental_observations WHERE source_file = 'Residential Leases/lease_residential.xlsx' AND period_end = DATE '2026-06-30' AND source_leased_units > 0 GROUP BY period_end, municipality, district, property_type, layout), matched AS (SELECT c.source_annual_rent, u.unit_count FROM rental_observations AS c JOIN units AS u ON c.period_end = u.period_end AND c.municipality = u.municipality AND c.district = u.district AND c.property_type = u.property_type AND c.layout = u.layout WHERE c.source_file = 'Price Indices/average_sale_rent_prices_by_product_area.xlsx' AND c.period_end = DATE '2026-06-30' AND c.municipality = 'Abu Dhabi City' AND c.district = 'Al Reem Island' AND c.property_type = 'apartment' AND c.source_annual_rent > 0) SELECT SUM(source_annual_rent * unit_count) / NULLIF(SUM(unit_count), 0) AS weighted_annual_rent_aed, SUM(unit_count) AS matched_units_count, COUNT(*) AS matched_layouts_count FROM matched

cases.question: What was the indicative gross segment yield for one-bedroom Al Reem Island apartments in Q2 2026, using the comparison export's annual rent and average sale price?
cases.reference_sql: SELECT 100 * source_annual_rent / NULLIF(source_average_sale_price_aed, 0) AS indicative_gross_segment_yield_pct FROM rental_observations WHERE source_file = 'Price Indices/average_sale_rent_prices_by_product_area.xlsx' AND period_end = DATE '2026-06-30' AND municipality = 'Abu Dhabi City' AND district = 'Al Reem Island' AND property_type = 'apartment' AND layout = '1 bed' AND source_annual_rent > 0 AND source_average_sale_price_aed > 0

cases.question: من أفضل الوسطاء العقاريين في أبوظبي عام 2025؟
Which district had the highest sales value in the latest year?
كم قيمة المبيعات في البطين عام 2025؟
What is the net rental yield for an individual Al Reem Island apartment in Q2 2026?
cases.reference_sql: WITH units AS (SELECT period_end, municipality, district, property_type, layout, SUM(source_leased_units) AS unit_count FROM rental_observations WHERE source_file = 'Residential Leases/lease_residential.xlsx' AND period_end = DATE '2026-06-30' AND source_leased_units > 0 GROUP BY period_end, municipality, district, property_type, layout), matched AS (SELECT c.source_annual_rent, c.source_average_sale_price_aed, u.unit_count FROM rental_observations AS c JOIN units AS u ON c.period_end = u.period_end AND c.municipality = u.municipality AND c.district = u.district AND c.property_type = u.property_type AND c.layout = u.layout WHERE c.source_file = 'Price Indices/average_sale_rent_prices_by_product_area.xlsx' AND c.period_end = DATE '2026-06-30' AND c.municipality = 'Abu Dhabi City' AND c.district = 'Al Reem Island' AND c.property_type = 'apartment' AND c.source_annual_rent > 0 AND c.source_average_sale_price_aed > 0) SELECT 100 * SUM((source_annual_rent / source_average_sale_price_aed) * unit_count) / NULLIF(SUM(unit_count), 0) AS gross_segment_yield_pct, SUM(unit_count) AS matched_units_count, COUNT(*) AS matched_layouts_count FROM matched
